dict.string: PopBar uses automation to read the browser's current URL for clipping, to create Calendar events, to manage your Login Items via System Events, and to ask Finder to move protected leftover folders (such as app containers) to the Trash in Disk Cleanup.
PopBar adds an event to the "PopBar" calendar for each completed Pomodoro focus round when you turn this on.
PopBar uses the camera for screen recording picture-in-picture and for the Hardware Inspection camera test when you run it.
PopBar scans your local network for TVs with ADB debugging enabled so TV Remote can find and control them.
PopBar uses the microphone for screen recordings and for the Hardware Inspection microphone test when you run it.
PopBar keeps your Today to-dos in sync with the "PopBar" list in Reminders when you turn this on.
